principles: Deterministic scripts execute tests; AI never decides PASS or Physical PASS.
Every physical run is bound to the exact release ZIP SHA-256 and freshly collected evidence.
AI is invoked only for a normalized failure packet after a deterministic stage fails.
A repair creates a new artifact SHA and invalidates prior physical certification for release purposes.
Open-source product dependencies are installed by the product installer from immutable bundle inputs; the lab does not replace product ownership with ad-hoc manual installs.

serverTiers.purpose: One single-node Factory management appliance plus one Compact-3 OKD target for import, reconnect and revocation certification.
notes: The lab runner itself can execute from an operator workstation and is not counted as a server.
If a real existing OKD cluster is already supplied, only the management server is additional.
resourceSummary: Management node: 4 vCPU / 16 GiB RAM / 100 GiB free disk (4SO lab floor; above RKE2 minimum to leave headroom for PostgreSQL, Forgejo, zot, Keycloak and control-plane workloads).
Each OKD control node: 4 vCPU / 16 GiB RAM / 100 GB storage / 300 IOPS minimum; faster etcd storage is recommended.

matrix.name: Exact-SHA integrity and provenance
matrix.automationDetail: Exact archive verification, persistent private SHA snapshot binding, exclusive run-state fencing, immutable release/topology/spec/bundle run-state binding, distinct physical server inventory validation/digest binding and management-host preflight are automated.

matrix.name: Fresh single-node management install
matrix.automationDetail: Fresh single-node management installation validates managed identity adminEmail and appliance dnsZone before mutation, uses only the exact verified disconnected bundle, seals the exported Installer access token under LAB_INSTALLER_ACCESS_TOKEN_FILE_AUTHORITY_V1 for safe same-binding resume, and automates exact-artifact field evidence, real host boot-id change, installer-service recovery, post-reboot Installer verification and post-reboot exact-SHA evidence recollection. Physical PASS still requires the independent four-layer release gate.

matrix.name: Fresh three-node management HA
matrix.automationDetail: Fresh three-node management HA installation additionally requires an explicit HTTPS public endpoint and external S3 URL/bucket/external-secret credential authority before mutation, uses the same exact disconnected bundle/token-resume boundary, then performs deterministic post-quorum Installer-service interruption, durable same-run explicit resume, full three-node quorum verification, a real rke2-server peer restart, observed peer reboot outage, degraded two-node quorum proof, boot-ID change and full three-node recovery. These automated actions produce row evidence only; they do not imply the independent four-layer release Physical PASS.

matrix.name: PostgreSQL exact-runtime persistence and migration
matrix.automationDetail: The production-HA runner binds M03 to the exact CloudNativePG runtime installed by the same M02 run. It discovers the current primary/service/cluster CA over strict management SSH, creates an ephemeral certifier role/database inside that runtime without persisting credentials, tunnels to the service with TLS verify-full, runs migrations/CRUD/concurrency and AI dispatch/result atomicity under AI_RUN_POSTGRES_DURABILITY_RUNTIME_AUTHORITY_V1, proves the durable AI claim/run pair survives a real primary restart, verifies backup/restore plus post-restore AI durability, re-verifies three-node PostgreSQL/API recovery, and drops all certifier-owned databases plus the role. Row evidence remains independent from the four-layer release Physical PASS, and the AI/PostgreSQL blocker remains pending until physical execution.

providers.use: bounded diagnosis/repair with explicit turn and budget caps
preferred low-token structured failure diagnosis through the unified platformctl AI runtime; use a cost-efficient model first and escalate only after unresolved product-defect classification
self-hosted/vLLM or compatible endpoint through the unified platformctl AI runtime
interactive/subagent investigation through a custom command adapter

aiPolicy.egressPolicy: central redaction before every provider; bounded JSON context; raw prompts and credentials are not durable authority
aiPolicy.durableAudit: successful model calls become project-scoped ai_runs with prompt/context/output digests, token usage and redaction count
aiPolicy.executionAuthority: AI is advisory only; all changes continue through deterministic product plans, RBAC, approvals and durable operations

mcp.defaultAccess: read-only; delegated mutation requires explicit mcp.operate on a platform-operator service account or operator/admin product role
mcp.authorization: product authentication plus scoped RBAC; read tools require mcp.read for API tokens; delegated mutations require mcp.operate and write access; approval tools are exposed only to human ADMINISTRATION delegations, re-evaluate current RBAC/resource scope and reject requester self-approval; identity administration remains job-backed and Keycloak credentials remain server-side
mcp.externalClient: python3 scripts/mcp_external_client_certify.py --endpoint <api>/mcp; separate-process TCP black-box validation with project-scope negative control

runner.targetHostSSHPolicy: Phase C uses root SSH only for management roles; existing OKD target nodes are not required to permit root SSH for import certification.
runner.bundlePolicy: Run requires a verified immutable appliance bundle until canonical automatic digest-locked acquisition is implemented; absence is BLOCKED, never latest-download fallback.
runner.physicalPassPolicy: No individual runner stage, AI diagnosis, MCP call or management install alone may produce four-layer Exact-SHA Physical PASS.
